key_insight: Agentic source analysis can compress a large logic-optimization operator set into a smaller exact, theory-derived subset by turning implementation-level conditions into certified admission gates.
engineering_relevance: For synthesis flows, this means faster orchestration with the same outputs, plus a more compact and predictable operator vocabulary for production use.
method: LLM agents read pinned ABC and mockturtle source code to infer operator-level relations.
Adversarial audits test the claimed scope of each relation and gate.
Certified relations are compiled into deterministic gates and integrated into ABC Orchestrate as TACO.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a 31-action exact Pareto cover from 40 deployed actions, 11% runtime reduction with bit-identical outputs on 66 circuits, and up to 2.6× speedup in the integrated comparison.
watch_item: The gains depend on source-level assumptions and exact gate correctness, so portability to other codebases or future implementation changes may require re-verification.
paper_title: Rethinking Logic Optimization Operators: Theory-Derived Operator Compression via Agentic Source Analysis
